title: Ground-Truth-First Benchmarking of Reinforcement Learning via Converse Optimality: From Smooth, Fully Observed Systems to Non-Smooth or Partially Observed Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.30954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarking in reinforcement learning is usually relative: algorithms are ranked by returns on environments with unknown optima. Distance to optimality remains unobservable, while conclusions may depend on reward design, stochasticity, hyperparameters, environment selection, and simulator details. We develop a ground-truth-first framework based on converse optimality, constructing each task with a certified optimal value function and policy withheld from learners and used only for evaluation. The framework unifies two modes: sensitivity benchmarking samples certified environments from continuous-time generators to assess robustness to task variation, while oracle-referenced comparison uses native discrete-time generators to evaluate policies via optimality gap, regret, and policy error. translated_title: 基于逆最优性的强化学习“真值优先”基准测试：从平滑、完全可观测系统到非平滑或部分可观测任务
translated_abstract: 强化学习中的基准测试通常是相对的：算法在最优值未知的环境上根据回报进行排名。与最优性的距离始终不可观测，而结论可能依赖于奖励设计、随机性、超参数、环境选择和模拟器细节。我们开发了一个基于逆最优性的“真值优先”框架，为每个任务构建经过认证的最优值函数和策略，这些内容对学习者保密，仅用于评估。该框架统一了两种模式：敏感性基准测试从连续时间生成器中采样经过认证的环境，以评估算法对任务变化的鲁棒性；而以预言机为参照的比较则使用原生离散时间生成器，通过最优性差距、后悔值和策略误差来评估策略。连续时间模型支持物理上可解释的敏感性研究，但引入了对模拟器步长（Δt）和数值方案的依赖……
tldr: 该论文提出基于逆最优性的“真值优先”强化学习基准测试框架，通过预先构建并保密经认证的最优值函数与策略，使算法性能可通过最优性差距、后悔值和策略误差等指标进行绝对化评估，并同时支持对任务变化敏感性的系统性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a ground-truth-first reinforcement learning benchmarking framework based on converse optimality, where tasks are constructed with certified optimal value functions and policies withheld from learners, enabling absolute evaluation via optimality gap, regret, and policy error, as well as systematic sensitivity analysis across task variations.
